recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓出現大量小至中型、核形不規則甚至有裂痕或雙葉的非典型淋巴球，切片瀰漫浸潤；免疫染色 CD20、CD5 陽性、CD3 陰性，SOX11 強核陽性且 Ki-67 高，即使 cyclin D1 陰性仍支持母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Peripheral blood with numerous small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, cleaved to bilobed/binucleated-appearing nuclei with slightly condensed chromatin
Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy with diffuse sheets of similar atypical lymphoid cells
IHC: diffuse CD20 and CD5 positivity with CD3 highlighting only scattered T cells
Strong nuclear SOX11 in most tumor cells and high Ki-67 proliferation index
describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood contains numerous atypical small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular, cleaved and bilobed nuclear contours. The bone marrow aspirate and biopsy show diffuse replacement by similar cells. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are CD20-positive and CD5-positive, CD3 marks only scattered reactive T cells, SOX11 shows strong nuclear staining, and the Ki-67 proliferation index is high. In the stated absence of cyclin D1 protein and CCND1 rearrangement, findings are consistent with cyclin D1-negative, SOX11-positive blastoid mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FL cells are CD10+/BCL6+, CD5-negative and SOX11-negative with IGH::BCL2.
ATLL 'flower cells' are CD3+/CD4+/CD25+ T cells with HTLV-1 serology, not CD20+ B cells.
CLL is CD5+/CD23+ with dim FMC7 and SOX11-negative, and cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin rather than cleaved nuclei.
B-ALL blasts express TdT/CD34, lack surface light chain, and are CD5-negative.

stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC: CD20, CD5, CD3, SOX11, Ki-67
